name: RW06-B2 Extraction and provenance
description: RW06-B2 (RW06 real-world test). For each claim: sends the documents to Document Automation when a DocFlow process is given (set aside here), otherwise reads them itself: typed fields with page and line citations, a confidence score with an OCR fallback, a schema check, the invoice total against its line sum, invalid dates flagged, the model API version checked and a hash of the result kept.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Folder of the real-world tests: data, output and the stand-in server.

variables.name: run_id
variables.description: Run id shared by a main agent and its children; made here when empty.

variables.name: standin
variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.name: watch
variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.name: pause_seconds
variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.name: fault_profile
variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: exceptions
variables.description: Records routed to the exception list.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

variables.name: docflow_process
variables.description: A Document Automation process to send the documents to; empty: set aside, read here.

variables.name: api_version
variables.description: Model API version the extraction was tested with.

variables.name: evidence_file
variables.description: Evidence rows of this agent (one per record).

args.text: What this agent does: For each claim: sends the documents to Document Automation when a DocFlow process is given (set aside here), otherwise reads them itself: typed fields with page and line citations, a confidence score with an OCR fallback, a schema check, the invoice total against its line sum, invalid dates flagged, the model API version checked and a hash of the result kept. It works through 10 documents (the split claims) and writes its results to the run's output folder.
